summary: Trace synthetic markers across emission, Cribl routing, Splunk and Sentinel indexing, and detection evaluation to prove end-to-end pipeline health.
limitations: Operates offline with recorded stage evidence; does not make live network calls to production Cribl Stream workers or SIEM APIs.
Pipeline health reflects recorded evidence logs for synthetic markers and should not be confused with broad infrastructure telemetry uptime.
Automatic redaction strips common API keys, tokens, and passwords while strictly preserving synthetic correlation markers.

demo.description: Trace synthetic markers across Cribl-to-Splunk and Cribl-to-Sentinel pipelines, demonstrating healthy, degraded, and broken pipeline classifications.
